theorem_u.anomalous_note: n=p frequency blocks; form survives; |D|~n outside |D|<=p regime.
theorem_u.proof_sketch: |D| = sum_{a,t} fhat(a) hhat(t) S(a,t); S(0,0)=n-1; S(0,t!=0)=-1; |S(a!=0,t)| <= C(E)sqrt(p)+1; absorb main terms under the hypotheses.
theorem_u.statement: If |D| <= p and A_L(D) <= p/2 then |D| <= 4 (C(E) sqrt(p) + 1) A_x(D) A_L(D), with C(E) = max_{a!=0,t} |S(a,t)|/sqrt(p).
